status: not released: the acceptance criterion is not met, the random start (M07 own start) answers
criterion: median iterations to 1 percent at least two times below the random start, final efficiency and uniformity equal within 1 percent, model at most 1 MB

control_without_the_network.what: every second generated held-out geometry (30), seeds 301 to 303, budget 60; the learned start replaced by M07's random start, same n_fix
control_without_the_network.reading: the shorter freeze (n_fix 3) gives the fewer iterations where it converges; the network adds nothing over a random start with the same n_fix

oracle_bound.what: start from the trap phases of a converged random-start M07 solution, 10 held-out geometries, seed 301, N=256
oracle_bound.iterations: with n_fix 12 the oracle start still needs 13 to 16 iterations on dense lattices; with n_fix 2 to 4 it needs 5 to 7 where the random start needs 13 to 16
